verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API (which includes Billing endpoints for subscriptions, invoices, etc.), enabling natural-language-driven operation via an AI agent layer. However, this is evidenced only via first-party docs at the general Stripe API level, not Billing-specific NL commands, and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of it working well for Billing tasks. Missing for 10: Billing-specific natural-language examples, independent/hands-on validation of MCP-driven billing operations, and documented limitations/edge cases.
